column1: # TTU (Tree Traversal Unit = RT core) instruction set, decoded from the CUDA-13
# nvdisasm SM89 instruction-class tables and the SASS 128-bit encoding.
# The opcode field is {bit91, bits[11:0]} (13 bits); all TTU ops have bit91=0.
# Dedicated virtual queue VQ_TTU (=21). Consumer/graphics line only: sm_75 (6 classes,
# TTULD unsplit), sm_86/87/88/89 and sm_120/121 (7 classes); absent on sm_80, sm_90,
# sm_100, sm_103, sm_110. The sm_89 and sm_120 class sets are identical.
# Columns: op  opcode_hex  opcode_bits  operands  instruction_type  min_wait  scoreboard_role  note

column8: open/initialize a traversal context (after ray+root stored)
store a register pair into the TTU internal addr (ray/state fill)
load 128-bit hit result (Rd2:Rd) + predicate Pu from TTU internal addr
TTULD with /CLOSE: final result read + tear down the context
kick the autonomous BVH traversal (no register operands)
fused traversal macro; takes a 5-bit scoreboard immediate
